<?php
$o = new class {
    public int $liveSlot = 3;
    public $nullSlot = null;
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "CHECK:", $name, ";";
        return $name === "virtual";
    }
};
echo isset($o->liveSlot) ? "LIVE;" : "BAD;";
echo isset($o->nullSlot) ? "BAD;" : "NULL;";
echo isset($o->virtual) ? "YES;" : "BAD;";
echo isset($o->absent) ? "BAD;" : "NO;";

<?php
$o = new class {
    public int $pending;
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "I", $name, ";";
        return $name === "yes";
    }
};
echo isset($o->pending) ? "BAD;" : "INITIAL;";
echo isset($o->no, $o->yes) ? "BAD;" : "SHORT;";
echo isset($o->yes, $o->no) ? "BAD;" : "LAST;";
echo isset($o->yes, $o->yes) ? "ALL;" : "BAD;";

<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        global $o;
        $o = null;
        echo "RETIRE:", $name, ";";
        return true;
    }
};
$answer = isset($o->virtual);
echo $answer ? "YES;" : "BAD;";
echo $o === null ? "NULL;" : "BAD;";
